reference.sourceTitle: Yokosuka D4Y2-C, P. Endsleigh Castle, Aircraft Profile 241 plate (scan p.17)
reference.variant: D4Y2-C reconnaissance Model 1-2; external airframe used for D4Y2, bomber-bay internals not evidenced
notes: Manually digitised top/side silhouettes, independently registered to catalog length and wingspan.
Published reference drawing, not manufacturing geometry. Pixel rounding, scan distortion, hidden cross sections, canopy width and small details remain approximations.

Canopy lateral widths and hidden body contours are reconstructed inside the measured exterior envelope. Wing dihedral is digitised approximately from the front view, not an airfoil or load-bearing engineering specification.
Plan registration: source PDF page 17 rendered at 2x (2064x2784), reduced to 1376x1856; crop [80,330,1270,1300], rotate +66 degrees, expand. No nonuniform plan warping.
Illustrated D4Y2-C uses inline Atsuta engine; D4Y3/4 radial drawings deliberately excluded. Chin radiator is separate from primary fuselage loft.
